name: capell-app/site-stats
description: Counts your pages, sites, active sites and active domains every hour and keeps a daily record for global administrators.

healthChecks.label: Site Stats collector registration is available.

marketplace.summary: Keeps a daily count of pages, sites, active sites and active domains and shows each as a 30-day line on the Site metrics page.
marketplace.description: Each hour it counts the pages, sites, active sites and active domains in your own content. The last count of each day is kept, and global administrators see the latest figures with a 30-day line on the Site metrics page. A day your scheduled tasks miss has no figure, and the health check flags it. Nothing about visitors is read.
marketplace.problem: Nobody can say how many pages, sites and domains an install holds, or whether those numbers are growing.
marketplace.outcome: Global administrators see the latest totals and a 30-day line for each on the Site metrics page.

faq.question: What does Site Stats count?
faq.answer: Each hour it counts your pages, sites, active sites and active domains and keeps the last count of each day.

faq.question: Who can see the figures?
faq.answer: Global administrators, on the Site metrics page in the Capell admin. Someone who looks after a single site never sees totals for the rest.

faq.question: Does it collect visitor analytics?
faq.answer: No. It only counts your own pages, sites and domains, reads nothing about visitors, and nothing leaves your server.

faq.question: What happens on a day the counting does not run?
faq.answer: That day has no figure, and it cannot be added later because a count only describes what exists right now. The health check flags a gap of 24 hours without a count.
